podcast.title: Offshoot of Emo
podcast.body: Emo Pop emerged as a subgenre from the broader emo movement, retaining the sensitive lyrical themes but incorporating more pop hooks and single melodies, exemplified by bands like Fall Out Boy and Panic! At The Disco. "There was Emo Pop, same grounding and sensitive matters, but with more pop hooks and single melodies, this is where followed boy and panic at the disco would end up."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Subgenre of Third Wave Emo
podcast.body: Emo-pop emerged as one of the fragmented variations and subgenres within the third wave of emo. "Emo-pop, screamo bands, just a couple of examples."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
